name: Fliki
tagline: Fliki converts blog posts, scripts, tweets, and text into engaging videos using AI-generated voiceovers in 75+ languages and 1,300+ voices. It automatically matches relevant stock footage and images to the narration. Content marketers and educators use it to repurpose written content into video format with minimal effort.
